title: Custom eggless birthday cakes now serving Marsden Park and Schofields
summary:
Every cake sold at our Riverstone store is 100% eggless. Not some. Not most. Every single one — buttercream included.

Families in Marsden Park and Schofields ask the same question before ordering: is the icing eggless too, or only the sponge? All 15 flavours, all three finishes, zero eggs anywhere in the process.

That matters for Jain and halal-observant families who need the answer to already be no — not something to double-check at pickup.

48 hours minimum notice. Free parking in the shopping centre car park. Pickup from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
